name: @blueprint/scenario-results
description: Gate-G4 reporter/normalizer. Turns the test runners' JSON reporter output into the _scenario-results.json contract that state-derive's scenario_passes check consumes. Parses recorded evidence; never executes tests.
//: Zero runtime deps (vitest is a dev/test-only dependency provided by the parent workspace). Reads ../state-derive/types.ts for the ScenarioRun/ScenarioResults contract. Intentionally outside the project's npm workspaces graph.
